about.title: A Welcoming School With a Vision for Excellence
about.p1: New Generation Day Care Nursery & Primary School is a welcoming learning community committed to providing children with a strong educational foundation in a safe, supportive and engaging environment.
about.p2: Located in Tabata Chang'ombe, Machimbo Ward, Ilala District, Dar es Salaam. The school nurtures knowledgeable, disciplined, confident and responsible children while developing curiosity, creativity and independence.
about.visionText: To be the most student-centred school, inspiring, empowering, and nurturing our learners so that they become strong and successful individuals.
about.missionText: To provide a safe, inclusive and supportive learning environment where every student can thrive academically, socially and emotionally.

academics.title: Quality Education at Every Stage
academics.subtitle: From Day Care through Nursery and into Primary — a seamless, high-quality educational journey.
academics.nurseryDesc: Our Nursery programme nurtures curiosity and creativity in a warm, play-based environment. Children develop foundational social, emotional, and cognitive skills through guided exploration, storytelling, music, and hands-on activities that spark a lifelong love of learning.
academics.primaryDesc: Our Primary programme follows the Tanzania NECTA curriculum, providing rigorous academic instruction alongside character development, sports, and extracurricular activities. Every child is supported to reach their full potential.
academics.dayDesc: Our Day Care programme provides a safe, nurturing environment for our youngest learners. Through play, song, and gentle structured activities, children begin their educational journey with joy and confidence.

rules.title: Rules & Regulations
rules.subtitle: All students are expected to uphold these rules to ensure a safe, respectful, and productive learning environment.
rules.footer: These rules apply to all students. Parents/guardians are encouraged to review them with their children.
rules: All students must attend school regularly.
Students are required to always be punctual.
The school gate will be closed at 9:00 am; pupils who arrive after this time will not be allowed to enter.
Students must remain quiet, attentive, and well-behaved during lessons.
Students must wear a neat school uniform and maintain high standards of personal hygiene.
Hair plaiting is permitted for girls; boys must keep their hair short and tidy.
Students are not allowed to bring valuables or large sums of money to school.
The use of vulgar or abusive language is strictly prohibited. Any student who steals or engages in fighting that causes serious injury to others may be dismissed from school.
Students must show respect to teachers, elders, and national as well as school symbols.
Students must keep the school campus clean and must not damage any school property.
Students are responsible for taking care of their personal belongings.
Students are not allowed to leave the school campus during learning hours without permission.
Students are required to speak English while at school.

Students must maintain a minimum of 90% attendance to qualify for promotion to the next class. Any student who is absent for 14 consecutive days without authorization may be removed from the school register, including cases related to non-payment of school fees.

admissions.title: Join the New Generation Family
admissions.subtitle: Our admissions process is simple, transparent, and designed to welcome every family warmly. Admission forms are available physically at the school.
admissions.pageSubtitle: Simple, transparent, and welcoming. Start your child's journey with us.
admissions.step1Desc: Browse our website to learn about our programmes, facilities, and school values.
admissions.step2Desc: Fill in the simple online form to request an interview date and time.
admissions.step3Desc: Our team will contact you by SMS or phone call to confirm your interview appointment.
admissions.step4Desc: Visit the school for the interview. Bring required documents for verification.
admissions.step5Desc: Complete the admission form physically at school and pay the TZS 20,000 fee.
admissions.formSubtitle: Fill in the form below to request your preferred interview date and time. We will contact you by SMS or phone.
admissions.successMsg: Thank you! We have received your interview request. Our team will contact you by SMS or phone call to confirm your appointment.
admissions.statusSubtitle: Enter your phone number to check the status of your application.
admissions.noteText: The admission form is filled physically at the school. Payment of TZS 20,000 is made in person. No online payments are accepted. Additional documents must be brought physically for verification.
